args.body:
Hi Linda,

Thanks for reaching out. Batch invoicing will not ship this week. The payments-api 2026.09.4 release has been postponed from tonight to Monday, 2026-09-28 at 02:00 UTC.

What happened: during the staging dry-run of a database migration (adding invoice_batch_id to ledger_entries), an ACCESS EXCLUSIVE lock was held for almost 12 minutes on staging-sized data. Since production is roughly nine times larger, we're rewriting the migration to add the column without a default and backfill in batches rather than risk a long lock during business hours.

There is no customer impact — the current release (2026.09.3) is live and healthy. Batch invoicing is the headline item in .4, so it moves to Monday along with the release.

You can let Harrow & Finch know the feature will be available Monday, September 28.

Thanks,
Platform on-call
